title: Why the CDC is excluding measles deaths in Pennsylvania even as outbreak appears to be ‘accelerating’
punchline: Data gaps fueling public health uncertainty.
caption:
The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is currently not reporting four measles deaths in Pennsylvania, despite an accelerating outbreak. Medical professionals warn that the state is seeing new, rare forms of the disease, including congenital cases in newborns.

Pennsylvania has officially reported 731 cases, but experts believe this is a significant undercount due to limited testing. With the outbreak spreading, hospitals are preparing for increased admissions, as the current death and hospitalization rates appear disproportionate to typical projections.

Members of Congress have requested an immediate briefing regarding the CDC's reporting methodology. While the CDC is working to establish a new death definition, critics argue that the delay in acknowledging these deaths hinders effective contact tracing and public safety efforts. 🚨

As medical providers struggle to contain the virus, they emphasize that community immunity remains the only path to slowing the spread. How much should the public trust official health data when local doctors report a different reality?

title: Democrat says ICE restricted her oversight visit to country’s largest detention camp
punchline: Rules for thee, but not for me.
caption:
US Representative Veronica Escobar reported that federal immigration officials prevented her from speaking with detainees during an oversight visit to the Camp East Montana facility in Texas. The visit followed reports of two significant disturbances at the site, which is the nation's largest ICE detention center.

Escobar, who represents the El Paso region, stated she was denied access to detainees and has yet to receive requested surveillance footage of the recent incidents. She characterized the administration's actions as a deliberate attempt to impede congressional oversight of immigration facilities.

The facility, a 'soft-sided' tent camp at Fort Bliss, has faced ongoing criticism since its construction. Recent reports indicate that security staff lost control of the population during two separate events in early September, contradicting initial accounts provided to the lawmaker.

This incident marks another hurdle in the ongoing struggle between lawmakers and the administration over transparency in immigration detention. Should members of Congress have unrestricted access to all federal detention facilities? ⚖️
